episodes.title: Buffett Speakers, Paddles, and Flamingos
episodes.recap: Saturday brought Gary a sheepish apology to Hal over the knocked-out Buffett speaker, and Donna lured him to the Rec Center for paddle practice and free coffee. Rosa invited Gary, Donna, and Hal to a welcome dinner tonight at six, and Gary accepted, promising to leave the cart talk in the garage. Hal, dutifully filing reports at Town Hall, has logged Gary's unapproved cart wiring and Donna's flamingo collection under rule L-02. Gary is hoping to rig his cart for the Holiday Golf Cart Parade, and Donna is hoping to climb the pickleball ladder with him as her partner.

standings.gary: Admitted his wiring is unapproved, and is now headed to pickleball and dinner with Rosa.
standings.donna: Has Gary on the court for pickleball, though he warned he'll be terrible at it.
standings.hal: Filed a report on Gary's cart and a complaint about Donna's flamingos at Town Hall.
standings.rosa: Hosting a welcome dinner tonight at six, with all three neighbors invited.

next_time: Will Gary's cart lights and sound get Architectural Review sign-off before the parade?
How will Donna's flamingo collection fare under rule L-02?

episodes.title: Paddles, Pickles, and a Pending Cart Report
episodes.recap: Gary has never held a paddle, but Donna has him rallying on Court 1 at the Rec Center, and he's already calling himself a natural after three lucky volleys. Saturday at eight is now penciled in as doubles on the ladder board, with Donna insisting he cannot say no. Hal is filing both reports at Town Hall, logging Gary's unapproved cart lights and Donna's flamingo complaint under codes L-01 and L-02. Rosa is still hoping to fit a welcome dinner at six around one table, and Gary is quietly sketching cart wiring at his workbench.

standings.gary: Declared a natural after three rallies, booked for Saturday doubles, and back to the cart wiring at home.
standings.donna: Has Gary as her doubles partner on the ladder board for Saturday at eight.
standings.hal: Two filings logged at Town Hall, one on Gary's cart and one on Donna's flamingos.
standings.rosa: Still working out her shifts to host the welcome dinner for all three neighbors.

next_time: Will Gary make it to Rosa's welcome dinner at six, or will the cart eat his evening?
Will the review committee rule on the Kowalski cart and the flamingo count?

episodes.title: Paddles, Parades, and a Dinner Date
episodes.recap: Gary is now a pickleball doubles partner, and Donna has promised him a spare paddle, iced tea, and a Saturday morning court. Hal's two Town Hall filings, one on Gary's cart lights and wiring, one on Donna's flamingos, are still on the books as violations L-01 and L-02, and he's logging dated entries. Rosa has invited Hal to her welcome dinner Saturday at six, and he's agreed to come with only his appetite. Gary, warm and sheepish, is sorting his cart lights for the Holiday Golf Cart Parade. Previously, Donna had Gary rallying on Court 1, while Rosa was still juggling her shifts to host the dinner.

standings.gary: Booked for pickleball doubles with Donna tomorrow morning, rushing to sort his cart lights, and still under Hal's L-01 report.
standings.donna: Triumphant and recruiting Gary as her doubles partner, with a spare paddle and iced tea ready, though Hal has filed her flamingos under L-02.
standings.hal: Dutifully logging filings and counting flamingos, and has accepted Rosa's Saturday dinner invitation.
standings.rosa: Optimistic, with Saturday dinner at six on, and Hal confirmed as a guest.

next_time: Will Gary's cart lights and wiring pass Hal's scrutiny before the Holiday Golf Cart Parade?
Will Hal keep the rulebook in his pocket at Rosa's table on Saturday night?

episodes.title: Lights, Flamingos, and a Court at Eight
episodes.recap: Tonight on Sumter Oaks, the rain has finally cleared, and Donna has booked Gary and herself a pickleball court for Saturday at eight, sending him home with a spare paddle and a garage-door dink drill. Gary, meanwhile, is wiring a marine speaker into his golf cart battery, but Donna has warned him that anything visible from the street needs Architectural Review's blessing before Saturday. Hal, dutifully reflective at Town Hall, has trimmed Donna's flamingos to three and withdrawn that follow-up, while Gary's cart notice stays pending. Rosa has pinned her welcome dinner notice to the Magnolia Loop board, inviting Gary, Donna, and Hal to her place Saturday evening. Previously, Hal filed reports on Gary's cart lights and Donna's flock, Rosa accepted Hal's dinner RSVP, and the parade and the pickleball ladder were both looming.

standings.gary: Wiring his cart speaker and rope lights, booked for Saturday's court at eight, and waiting on Architectural Review approval.
standings.donna: Cheerful and three flamingos lighter, with the court booked and Gary as her doubles partner.
standings.hal: Reflective at Town Hall, withdrew the flamingo follow-up, and his notice on Gary's cart remains pending.
standings.rosa: Determined, with her welcome dinner notice posted for Saturday evening at Magnolia Loop.

next_time: Will Gary get Architectural Review's blessing for his cart before Saturday's court time?
Will all three neighbors actually make it to Rosa's table on Saturday evening?

episodes.title: Doubles, Dinner, and a Thermos
episodes.recap: Tonight on Sumter Oaks, Gary has agreed to file his Architectural Review form before Thursday, keep his speaker at low volume before the ten o'clock quiet rules, and bring his paddle to Saturday's doubles match at eight. Donna is thrilled to have her partner, and Rosa has invited both of them to her welcome dinner that same evening, insisting the winners and losers share her cooking. Hal, reflective as ever, sat on a bench in Town Square with a single scoop of butter pecan and looked over the parade sign-up sheet. Previously, Hal filed reports on Gary's cart lights and Donna's flamingos, Donna trimmed her flock to three, and Hal withdrew that follow-up while Gary's cart notice stays pending.

standings.gary: Promised to file his Architectural Review form by Thursday and keep the speaker quiet, with Saturday's doubles match at eight and a dinner invitation to follow.
standings.donna: Delighted with her partner and her dinner invite, with a spare paddle ready and her flamingos cut to three.
standings.hal: Reflective on a bench in Town Square, his notice on Gary's cart still pending while he withdrew the flamingo follow-up.
standings.rosa: Hopeful and busy, hosting Saturday's welcome dinner and planning the menu with both neighbors invited.

next_time: Will Gary's Architectural Review form be filed by Thursday, and will the speaker stay quiet enough to keep the peace?
Can Donna and Gary win their Saturday doubles match, and will Hal finally sit at Rosa's table?

episodes.title: Flamingos, Forms, and a Fateful Serve
episodes.recap: Tonight on Sumter Oaks, Donna has trimmed her pink flamingo flock to three and Hal has squared the matter with a handshake and a nod, so no violation notice will be needed. Gary, hunting the Architectural Review form at Town Hall with a determined stride, still has his cart notice pending. Saturday at eight, Donna and Gary are booked for the pickleball courts, and Rosa's welcome dinner waits that same evening. Previously, Hal filed reports on Gary's cart lights and Donna's flamingos, Donna trimmed her flock, and Hal withdrew that follow-up while Gary's cart notice stays pending.

standings.gary: Heading to Town Hall to file his Architectural Review form, with his cart notice still pending and Saturday's doubles match at eight.
standings.donna: Content and square with Hal, her flamingos cut to three and a Saturday court date with Gary on the calendar.
standings.hal: Satisfied that Donna's flock is compliant, his flamingo follow-up withdrawn, and Gary's cart notice still on the docket.
standings.rosa: Determined and busy, sneaking a shopping run between shifts to keep Saturday's welcome dinner on track.

next_time: Will Gary's Architectural Review form clear Town Hall in time to keep his cart notice from hanging over the parade?
Can Gary survive his first doubles match with Donna on Saturday, and will he make it to Rosa's dinner afterward?

episodes.title: Lights, Sound, and a Saturday Dinner
episodes.recap: Tonight on Sumter Oaks, Gary is determined to file his golf cart form for lights and a sound system, and his cart notice remains pending at the Town Hall desk. Donna has cut her flamingos to three, and she and Gary are set for pickleball at eight on Saturday, with Rosa's welcome dinner at six that evening. Rosa has been hunting Gary across Magnolia Loop all afternoon, while Hal keeps his inspections of Gary's cart on the books. Earlier, Hal reported Gary's cart lights and Donna's flamingos, and Hal withdrew the flamingo follow-up after Donna trimmed her flock.

standings.gary: Pacing Magnolia Loop, his cart form still needing filing and his cart notice still pending, with Saturday's doubles match and Rosa's dinner both waiting.
standings.donna: Cheerful and square with Hal, her flamingos trimmed to three, and bringing dessert to Rosa's Saturday table.
standings.hal: Dutiful as ever, his flamingo follow-up withdrawn while Gary's cart modifications remain under review.
standings.rosa: Determined and still hunting Gary down to confirm Saturday's six o'clock welcome dinner.

next_time: Will Gary ever catch up with Rosa and actually receive her Saturday dinner invitation?
Will Gary's golf cart form get filed, and will his cart notice be settled before the Holiday Golf Cart Parade?

episodes.title: Light Strips, Pickleball, and a Pie
episodes.recap: Tonight on Sumter Oaks, Gary is wiring light strips and a speaker bracket onto his golf cart, but the power stays off until the Architectural Review Committee signs off on his paperwork. Donna is penciling in an eight o'clock Saturday pickleball match with Gary, and she's bringing dessert to Rosa's welcome dinner at six. Rosa is still hunting Gary down to confirm his seat at a table set for four, while Hal promises a pie from the commissary lady's recipe. Hal is also keeping a sharp eye on Magnolia Loop, where his flamingo complaint against Donna has been withdrawn now that she's trimmed her flock to three. Earlier, Hal reported Gary's cart lights, and Gary's modification notice remains pending.

standings.gary: Still wiring his cart in the dark, paperwork unfiled, with Saturday's pickleball and dinner both waiting on him.
standings.donna: Cheerful and square with Hal after trimming her flamingos, and bringing dessert to Rosa's Saturday table.
standings.hal: Dutiful as ever, his flamingo follow-up withdrawn while Gary's cart notice stays under review, and a pie on the way.
standings.rosa: Warm but determined, still trying to pin Gary down for her Saturday table of four.

next_time: Will Gary finally get his cart modification form filed before Saturday?
Will Rosa manage to catch Gary standing still long enough to confirm his seat at six?

episodes.title: Beans, Rolls, and a Peach Cobbler
episodes.recap: Tonight on Sumter Oaks, Gary has promised baked beans and a clean shirt for Rosa's Saturday welcome dinner at six, while Donna is bringing peach cobbler and booking him for an eight o'clock pickleball lesson. Rosa, determined to get everyone at one table, has her menu set and is already cooking. Over on Magnolia Loop, Hal is logging the day's flamingo count, since Donna's flock now stands at three and his complaint has been withdrawn. Gary's cart lights stay switched off, and his modification form remains under review until the Architectural Review Committee signs off. Earlier, Hal's notice on the cart lights and Donna's pink flamingos set the neighborhood buzzing.

standings.donna: Pleased and bustling, bringing peach cobbler and drafting Gary for Saturday pickleball.
standings.hal: Dutiful as ever, his flamingo complaint withdrawn while Gary's cart notice stays pending.
standings.rosa: Content and organized, hosting six o'clock dinner and tending to her menu.

episodes.title: Cobbler, Paddles, and Solder Oh My
episodes.recap: Tonight on Sumter Oaks, the golden Thursday hush falls over Magnolia Loop as Gary, solder in hand, finally says yes to Rosa's six o'clock welcome dinner Saturday, bottle and appetite included. Donna has pinned him down for pickleball at eight sharp, promising a spare paddle and assuring him nobody expects him to be good yet. Hal keeps his binoculars trained on the Loop, his flamingo complaint against Donna withdrawn now that her flock stands at three, while Gary's cart notice waits on the Architectural Review Committee. Earlier, Rosa set her menu, Donna pledged peach cobbler, and Gary's light string and sound system wiring took shape in his garage.

standings.donna: Triumphant, with peach cobbler and a paddle ready for Saturday's court.
standings.hal: Vigilant on his porch, his flamingo complaint withdrawn while Gary's notice stays pending.

episodes.title: Flamingos, Beans, and a Pecan Pie Peace Treaty
episodes.recap: Tonight on Sumter Oaks, a rainy Friday afternoon brings a flamingo summit to Magnolia Loop! Donna has agreed to pull all but three of her pink lawn birds before Saturday, and Hal, bless his binoculars, promises a pecan pie and folding chairs for Rosa's six o'clock dinner. Meanwhile, Gary is sealing Marge's beans for the feast, and Rosa is checking her per-diem shifts so nothing dares steal her Saturday. Earlier, Donna's court time was locked in for eight sharp, and the Architectural Review Committee still holds Gary's cart lights and sound system in its hands.

standings.donna: Pulling her flamingos down to three and cobbler-bound for Saturday's table.
standings.hal: Peace-keeping pecan pie bearer, his flamingo complaint withdrawn while Gary's cart notice stays pending.

episodes.title: Flamingos Thinned, Beans Sealed, Pickles Pending
episodes.recap: Tonight on Sumter Oaks, a rainy Friday turns into a night of bold preparations! Gary tested his cart's light strip and speaker wiring while Donna dropped by to coach him, promising a 7:45 pickup for pickleball and a spare paddle, and Hal, bless his binoculars, filed his L-01 report at Town Hall on Gary's unapproved lights and speaker. Donna has thinned her flamingo flock to just three, Rosa has seasoned her pork and set her good plates for four, and by evening everyone is tucked in, nervous but hopeful. Earlier, Gary's cart notice remains pending before the Architectural Review Committee, and Rosa's Saturday dinner is still on the calendar.

standings.donna: Content with three flamingos standing, pickleball plans set for 7:45 sharp.
standings.hal: Dutiful, his L-01 report filed and the flamingo count under review.
